entries.en: fishhook; hook
entries.notes: R 栏 kāū 近「鉤」之官话读，H 栏却作「釣」，字形与对音不一致，故降等。

entries.en: fishhook (small); hook
entries.notes: H 栏带 [疑]，L 栏「ancelo」为 anzuelo 之异拼。

entries.zh: 带柄（带钓线）的鱼钩；饵钓之钩
entries.en: fishhook with a shank/line; baited hook
entries.notes: R 栏 xūn kiān sīn 与 H/M 三字不合，疑错行或残讹；释义据 L「con cabo」与 H/M。

entries.zh: 〔非词条，原件汉、闽南、官话三栏皆空〕字母 A 部标目，置于 P 之前
entries.en: [not a lexical entry] section running head: letter A, before P
entries.notes: 三栏皆 [空]，此行实为字母分段标目「A. ante. P.」，非词汇条目，不作释义。

entries.en: to insert; to plant; to place (in position)
entries.notes: L 栏「A Baijvar.」疑为分写讹形，未能还原西语原式；释义据 H/M/R「安插」定。

entries.zh: 认契（拜干亲），做教父、干爹
entries.en: to act as godfather; to sponsor at baptism (契, fictive kinship)

entries.zh: 做教父；代为求情（原稿字形可疑）
entries.en: to act as godfather; to intercede for someone
entries.notes: H 栏「艋」为罕见字且带疑，M/R 仅单音节且不合；L 栏又拼合 apadrinar 与残断的 aparat:，四栏不能互证。

entries.en: to extinguish; to put out (fire, light)
to put out a fire with wind; to fan the flames
entries.notes: L 栏后半「viendo ceros onde à piedra É」残讹难通，释义据前半 apagar el fuego con el viento 与 H/M「搧火」。

entries.en: to beat out a fire; to put out fire by striking
entries.notes: 旁注「Lor pleng.」未能解读；「打火」常义为取火，此处从 L「apagar」释为扑打灭火。

entries.en: to beat out (flames, sparks)
entries.notes: H「打花」常义为开花或打火花，与 L「appagar(apagar)」难确配，仅据系列语境暂释，语义无法定夺。

entries.en: to beat out (a fire); to extinguish by striking
to put out a candle; to snuff out a candle
entries.notes: R 栏中段标 [残]、末字对音失准；H/M 完整，释义无碍。

entries.en: to blow out (a flame)
entries.notes: L 栏「boplard.」为 soplar（吹）之讹写；H/M/R 三栏一致为吹熄。

entries.en: the fire has gone out; it is extinguished
the fire has already gone out (colloquial)
entries.notes: H 栏末字「勝」带疑，M/R 均作「啦」，从之；L「apagaseya」即 apagóse ya。

entries.en: to fight a fire; to put out a blaze
entries.notes: L 栏「en q. seque ma la cara &」残讹难通，释义据 apagar el fuego 与 H/M「救火」。

entries.en: to cudgel; to beat with a stick
entries.notes: R 栏「tā cua teñ」较 H 栏单字「打」多出，未能对应。

entries.zh: 痛打，狠揍（打得骨头都疼）
entries.en: to give a sound beating; to thrash
entries.notes: R 栏「tā cua têñ」与 H「打骨頭」不对应，疑承上行而误；释义据 L/H/M。

entries.en: sideboard; cupboard; dresser
entries.notes: H 栏「佔/櫃」待定，M「Tiām」与 R「chièn」指向「佔/店」系，与 L「aparador」橱柜义不合，从 L 立义。

entries.en: to read a person's physiognomy; to tell fortunes by face
entries.notes: L 栏「Apareador. ŷ. paread.」原形未定，释义据 H/M/R 一致指向之「相人」。

entries.zh: 英烈显灵；亡魂（英灵）显现
entries.en: apparition of a spirit; a dead man's spirit appearing
entries.notes: L 栏「q. it. de s. hijo」为缩写残文，语义取「亡者之灵显现」，与 H「英烈」相配。
